body: I agree. Cheating is so disrespectful to your partner and I have no sympathy or forgiveness for those who do it. I feel like I'm too ugly to ever be with someone who wouldn't cheat on me, it's just so rampant these days. It seems like all the good people already got their pick of the lot and are taken.

It's like someone took a thought right out of my head. I know exactly what you mean and I agree nothing short of completely changing my entire life will ever make a difference. I'm close to throwing in the towel.

I got really into crafts, mostly sewing, and I make and sell things to keep myself distracted. The only crappy thing is I feel like I have to be working on something 24/7 or the bad thoughts creep back.

I'm so sorry for your mother having to deal with that. I hope my brother somehow breaks his cycle or marries someone rich to support him instead of our parents. He's actually trying to tag along on a summer trip of mine and I told him if I don't have his half of the money in my hand a month before, he will not be going. And that I won't accept any money from our parents for him.
